articles.title: Private Credit Is Scary. Get Those High Yields With Less Risk.
articles.mainIdea: Private Credit Is Scary. Get Those High Yields With Less Risk.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Private Credit Is Scary. Get Those High Yields With Less Risk.. For investors put off by private credit, there are high-yielding alternatives without the baggage. Broadly syndicated loans, generally originated by banks, are similar to private-credit loans because both go to speculative-grade companies and typically carry floating rates tied to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate, or SOFR, the short-term yield benchmark now around 3.7%. Related tickers mentioned: ARES, HYT, IVZ, JFR, OWL.
